Subject: POC kickoff: proposed slots + agenda (prompt inventory, routing, load test)

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Wed like to lock in a 90-minute kickoff/hands-on session where we can:
- Run through your prompt inventory (bring examples you want to validate)
- Map out routing and fallback policies for that inventory
- Confirm structured-output schemas and sample validations
- Run a short load test (controlled traffic profile) to validate latency and batching settings

Proposed windows next week (PST):
- Wed 2026-12-09 10:00-11:30
- Thu 2026-12-10 13:00-14:30
- Fri 2026-12-11 08:30-10:00

Also attaching: POC_Agenda_v2.pdf (walking agenda) and PromptInventory_Template.csv (fill in a handful of representative prompts). For the load test we typically ask for a 60-minute window where BrightPath can generate traffic from a staging client or we replay a sanitized log. If you already have a preferred traffic profile, please attach or point to it.

If none of those times work, tell me a couple of slots that do and well accommodate. Ill circulate a calendar invite once we pick a time and will loop in an ops runbook from Ben for the load test.

Thanks,
Soojin

Elena + team,

Friday 08:30-10:00 PST is workable from our side. Notes on the load test and what Ill bring:
- Load window: 60 minutes starting at 08:40 (gives time for setup and quick baseline).
- Traffic plan: we'll run a staged replay at ~100 concurrent requests peaking to 250 for 10 minutes to exercise batching. Im attaching a small example traffic profile (TrafficProfile.example.json).
- Observability: well stream logs to a temporary debug channel; we recommend you provide a staging token that will expire after the test.
- Structured output: please include 3 canonical examples (happy path, missing fields, extra fields). Well validate them against the schema in the session and produce a quick-lint report.

Action items for BrightPath before the session:
1) Populate PromptInventory_Template.csv with 10 representative prompts (free text ok).
2) Provide a staging endpoint and a staging API token (time-limited).
3) Share any compliance rules that affect output retention or redaction.

Ill prepare an ops runbook and the Replay orchestration script; will drop both in the Drive folder.

Ben
